starfall.name: Starfall
starfall.description: Where the stars come down. Hot, wild, and on fire.

st_landing.name: The Star Road
st_landing.description: A road of glass out of a crater, under a sky full of falling lights.

st_observatory.name: The Observatory
st_observatory.description: A domed observatory with a roof that's been patched a hundred times.

st_field1.name: The Crater Field
st_field1.description: Fresh craters, smoking. Another star comes down as you watch.

trap.name: a falling star
trap.hit: A star comes down beside you, and the blast throws you.
trap.avoid: You see it coming and run.
trap.sprung: {actor} is caught by a falling star!

sign.name: sky
sign.text: Stars fall all the time out there. Watch the sky, and keep moving.

st_heart.name: The Heart of the Fall
st_heart.description: The biggest crater, and in it the Fallen Star, still burning, still alive.

star_heart.name: Star Heart
star_heart.description: The Fallen Star's heart, still warm. One of three relics.

ilun.name: Ilun
ilun.label: Star-reader
ilun.description: an old star-reader with burned eyebrows
ilun.details: An old star-reader with burned eyebrows.

topics.work: Ask me about the shards, or the heart.

shards.text: The crystal golems grow from starshards. Break four and bring me what's left.

heart.text: The Fallen Star is alive, and angry. Its heart is a relic of yours, I think. Its starfire can't be stopped. Its ray can be dodged.

lure.sense: {Where}, the squeak of a great brass telescope turning.
lure.rumour: Ilun the star-reader is counting fallen stars.

effects.text: Ilun holds it up to the dome. "A crown, a pearl, a star. Old Harrow's door. Go home, and finish it."
